text_block_list.name: Curren Bouquetd'or
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for waiting... Oh? Chrono-san, 
you look a bit pale...?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
P-Please don't worry... It's just that, I 
couldn't... sleep very well...

text_block_list.name: Loves Only You
text_block_list.text:
I did tell her she really ought to get 
some sleep, even if she has to force 
herself, you know?

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... But no matter what... I just can't 
contain my excitement... —Today is the 
match of the century, after all...!

text_block_list.name: Chrono Genesis
text_block_list.text:
To think such a star-studded lineup has 
gathered...! Today's Japan Cup is going to 
be legendary!

text_block_list.name: Gran Alegria
text_block_list.text:
...We have to see it through to the end. 
The height of the wall we must overcome—
(Uwoooooooooah...!!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, feels like the ground is shaking. 
What incredible heat...

text_block_list.name: Lucky Lilac
text_block_list.text:
"...To be right at the center of a race 
like this, she really is an amazing girl."

text_block_list.name: Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ghh~~~, my heart is pounding! What's gonna 
happen, how's it gonna play out...!?

text_block_list.name: Blast Onepiece
text_block_list.text: Aiiiiiiiiii!! Do your beeeest!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"—Just listen to this tremendous roar from 
the crowd! The entire racecourse is 
practically shaking...!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A lineup of absolute titans has gathered! 
Truly a dream spectacle!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A battle among renowned Umamusume who 
carried an era and forged an era! Now, 
lining up side by side are—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume beloved by everyone, Kitasan 
Black!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
After winning her first G1 at the Kikuka 
Sho, she lit up race after race, including 
the Spring and Autumn Tenno Sho sweep!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Come on, bring on the cheers! ――Turning 
expectations into power is what I do!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: The dauntless noble lady, Gentildonna!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Achieved the Triple Tiara, and the 
first-ever consecutive Japan Cup 
victories— her path is nothing short of 
magnificent!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
No matter who the opponent is, there is 
only one thing to do. Prove this 
power—that is all.

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The renowned Umamusume who forged a new 
era and captivated the hearts of all who 
watched: Vodka!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
For the first time in 64 years, an 
Umamusume on the Tiara route has conquered 
the Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Ai... I know how strong you are. That's 
why! If I win—it's gonna be insane, right?

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Can you hear it, the melody that praises 
her! TM Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
With an undefeated record of 8 wins in 8 
races that year, she was crowned the 
End-of-Century Overlord!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hahahahaa!! —Ai-kun, do you possess the 
pride of a conqueror?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Every one of them a phenomenal Umamusume 
who achieved a historic record of 7 Turf 
GⅠ victories! And... and! The final one, 
naturally, is—!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: Symboli Rudolf!!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The first undefeated Triple Crown 
Umamusume in Twinkle Series history, and—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The first Umamusume in Twinkle Series 
history to achieve 7 Turf GⅠ victories!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Winning with such sheer dominance is a 
textbook display of racing! The path she 
carved out is truly the royal road of the 
racing world!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose you could call it ecstatic. 
To be given an opportunity like this, I 
can hardly contain my surging excitement.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: We are the pinnacle. Come at us—
—I can hear a murmur of voices.

Ahead of us... from beyond the light, 
passion, dreams, and hope spill forth.

Everyone is waiting. For change. And for 
the one who will bring it.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe, look. I'm trembling.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
That's true... I've never known this kind 
of frenzy before.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Trainer. Can I win?

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Do you think she's an Umamusume who can 
defeat the "strongest"?

"To be able to state that so boldly 
against talents of that caliber—it's 
because Almond Eye possesses a talent that 
surpasses even them."

It is the most primal wish. Something that 
every Umamusume possesses—
choice_data_list:
I want to win. That is the strongest drive 
of all!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yeah! You're right!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Of course! —The greatest joy ever!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Of course! —The greatest race of all!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text:
Of course! —The greatest history ever 
made!

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Well then, I'm off... Trainer.
choice_data_list: Yeah— Almond Eye. Go and win.
Yeah—Almond Eye. Go get that win.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: Yes.

text_block_list.name: Almond Eye
text_block_list.text: I will win. Against everything.
